summary: Pernod Ricard SA produces and sells wines and spirits worldwide. The company offers whiskey, vodka, gin, rum, liqueur and bitters, champagne, tequila and mezcal, and aperitif under the brands Ricard, Mumm, Perrier-Jouët, Martell, Malibu, Ballantine's, Chivas, Beefeater, Jameson, Havana Club, Royal Salute, The Glenlivet, Absolut, KI NO BI, The Chuan, Midleton Very Rare, Rabbit Hole, Royal Salute, Secret Speyside, Avion, Elyx Vodka, L'Orbe, Italicus, Lillet, Pernod, Suze, Augier, Malfy, Jefferson's, Lot No. 40, Powers, Redbreast, Smooth Ambler, TX, Method & Madness, Monkey 47, Plymouth Gin, Ceder's, Green Spot, Aberlour, Scapa, Altos, Del Maguey, Ostoya, Pastis 51, ARARAT, Seagram's Gin, Kahlúa, J.P. Wiser's, Ramazzotti, 100 Pipers, Blenders Pride, Imperial Blue, Royal Stag, Imperial, Longitude 77, Long John, Passport Scotch, Something Special, Olmeca, and Wyborowa. It also provides non-alcoholic beverages under the Seagram's, Beefeater, Cinzano Spritz, Suze Tonic, Ramazzotti Arancia, Almave Ambar, Almave Blanco, Lillet Blanc, and Pacific brand names. Pernod Ricard SA was founded in 1805 and is headquartered in Paris, France.
